title: 第十八章  抓风嗅鼻
content_zh:
众人回到招摇城时夜色已临。一进城芊芊就急不可耐，给众人讲述此次的遭遇，只是有意地隐去，墨非夜化身血灵的那段情节。

    芊芊被一群人，围在中间眉飞色舞：“看冰夷那么厉害，我想这下真跑不了，本姑娘必须为以后，好好打算打算。只是我和雨归尘两人，到时候不知道谁做大，谁做小。”

    旁边有人起哄打趣道：“芊芊姑娘，你这就不要你的夜了吗？”

    芊芊翻了个白眼：“你是猪吗，你不知道宓妃和羿的故事吗，到时候我家非夜，变得和羿一样厉害，再打瞎他另一只狗眼，抢我回来就是了。”

    当讲到四时剑出现时，万风良连连叫好，阴阳怪气地嘲讽道：“关键时刻还是要我剑宗出手，什么山神，水神有什么用。”

    旁边的城隍听到，拔出剑：“你们这些寄生虫，要不是山君大人看你们可怜，给你们一点栖身之地，你们连流浪狗都不如。”

    万风良从来不是什么好脾气，也针锋相对地拔出剑。

    万风良所在的剑宗，因为地处广乘山，按照礼制，原则上要受到，广乘山山神的约束。

    宗门在夏的布局中，原意是对英灵神系统的补充。

    五岳的中岳昆仑为九州祖龙，龙脉向四方蔓延而形成了其他四岳，四岳可能不是当地最高的山，可一定要是昆仑分枝。

    基于这个原因，中岳山神为至高山神，主管其他四岳山神。而其他四岳山神，主管自己龙脉分支上的城隍。这样一级级地下去，形成一个上下分明的英灵神系统。

    制约英灵神的活动范围的因素很多，比如祭祀范围，龙脉的走势，册封的领地等等，这也决定了英灵神系统，只能是一个偏重防御的系统。

    在山神城隍到不了的地方，就需要宗门出面。

    比如这次，在冰夷释放强大的力量后，连剑宗宗主都赶了过来，可是广乘山的山神却毫无办法。

    这就是矛盾所在，宗门认为山神，城隍空占气运，却没有什么用。

    事实并非如此，山神，城隍很大的作用是来镇守气运，并非占有。可在很多情况下，大家并不是，关注真相的本质，只是找到一个情绪的宣泄口。

    导致宗门对山神乃至整个英灵神的怨气越来越大。

    幸好英灵神在被重塑金身后，人性的本分就被脱离，只剩下纯粹的神性。一直以来对宗门的抱怨，都是至若惘然，这样养成了宗门弟子在英灵神面前口无遮拦的习惯。

    突如其来的剑拔弩张，是在场的所有人都没想到，谁也没见过城隍会，还会发脾气。

    “也许是封神还不久，人性的部分，还没有剥离干净？”这不光是是招摇侯的理解，也是其他人的想法。

    这段小插曲，让芊芊的演讲在不欢而散中结束。虽然大家都感觉，城隍的发怒不正常，可又没有人真正深入了解英灵神，就这样不了了之。

    等众人都离开中，城墙的阴影中出现两个人影，跟在墨非夜后面。

    墨非夜由于睡眠的原因，他包干了晚上所有的巡查任务。他知道厌火长期的进攻无力，让城中所有人都有些松懈。

    原本他也认为厌火软弱无力的进攻，是因为这批厌火能力不足。雨归尘的到来，让他将这种观点完全推翻。

    且不谈雨归尘嘴中的灾兽和萨满，就当时和雨归尘对战的厌火，只要是多来几个，招摇城都顶不住。

    从那时候，他就觉得厌火们的目标，可能另有阴谋，不是简单攻陷招摇城那么简单。

    在招摇侯的大力支持下，墨非夜的建议都被高效执行。各种物质整齐堆放，在指定的位置。按照性别年龄，重新分组的男女老少，也在各自的岗位上尽忠职守，不敢有一丝怠慢。

    墨非夜一路巡查，明显感到了群众的不快。早几天的时候，他们都会热情地给他打招呼，并感谢他来帮助守城。现在过去都是爱理不理，有些人的眼神中，明显带有怨恨。

    “怨气增长得太快。”这是墨非夜的感受，只是被围短短两个月，群众产生的怨气，就达到了同等城池，被围两年的水平。

    雨归尘两人跟在墨非夜后面，她知道等墨非夜查完那些檑木，就会通过旁边楼梯，上到城墙上检查哨位情况。现在的这个时间，楼梯上不会有人，就对她而言最好时机。

    “你有不死草？”
content_en:
Night had fallen when everyone returned to Zhaoyao City. As soon as she entered the city, Qianqian was impatient and told everyone about the encounter, but deliberately concealed the episode where Mo Feiye transformed into a blood spirit.

    Qianqian was surrounded by a group of people and beamed with excitement: "Seeing how powerful Bingyi is, I don't think I can really run away now. This girl must make good plans for the future. It's just me and Yu Guichen. I don't know who will be bigger and who will be smaller."

    Someone nearby was joking and joking: "Miss Qianqian, don't you want your night now?"

    Qianqian rolled her eyes: "Are you a pig? Don't you know the story of Concubine Mi and Yi? When my Feiye becomes as powerful as Yi, just blind his other dog eye and snatch me back."

    When it came to the appearance of the Four Seasons Sword, Wan Fengliang applauded repeatedly and sarcastically said: "I still need my Sword Sect to take action at the critical moment. What is the use of a mountain god or a water god?"

    The City God next to him heard this and drew his sword: "You parasites, if Lord Tiger hadn't seen you pitifully and given you a little shelter, you would be worse than stray dogs."

    Wan Fengliang has never been a good-tempered person, so he drew his sword tit for tat.

    Wan Fengliang's Jianzong was located in Guangcheng Mountain. According to the etiquette system, in principle, it was bound by the mountain god of Guangcheng Mountain.

    In Xia's layout, the original intention of the sect was to supplement the Heroic Spirit God system.

    Kunlun, the middle mountain among the five mountains, is the ancestral dragon of the Nine Provinces. The dragon's veins spread in all directions to form the other four mountains. The four mountains may not be the highest mountains in the area, but they must be branches of Kunlun.

    For this reason, the Zhongyue Mountain God is the highest mountain god and is in charge of the other four mountain gods. The other Siyue mountain gods are in charge of the city gods on their own dragon vein branches. Going down level by level in this way, a system of heroic spirits and gods with clear upper and lower levels is formed.

    There are many factors that restrict the scope of activities of the Heroic Spirit God, such as the scope of sacrifices, the trend of dragon veins, canonized territories, etc. This also determines that the Heroic Spirit God system can only be a defense-focused system.

    Where the mountain god and city god cannot reach, the sect needs to step forward.

    For example, this time, after Bingyi released its powerful power, even the master of the Sword Sect rushed over, but the mountain god of Guangcheng Mountain was unable to do anything.

    This is the contradiction. The sect believes that mountain gods and city gods control luck, but they are of no use.

    This is not the case. The main role of mountain gods and city gods is to guard luck, not to possess it. But in many cases, everyone does not pay attention to the essence of the truth, but just finds an outlet to vent their emotions.

    As a result, the sect became more and more resentful towards the mountain god and even the entire Heroic Spirit God.

    Fortunately, after the Heroic God was reshaped into gold, his human nature was separated, leaving only his pure divinity. The complaints against the sect all the time have always been in despair, which has developed the habit of sect disciples speaking openly in front of the Heroic Spirit God.

    The sudden tense situation was something that no one present had expected. No one had ever seen the City God Meeting and would lose their temper.

    "Perhaps it has not been long since he became a god, and the human part has not been completely stripped away?" This is not only the understanding of Zhao Yaohou, but also the thoughts of others.

    This little episode brought Qianqian's speech to an unhappy end. Although everyone felt that Cheng Huang's anger was abnormal, no one really understood the Heroic God deeply, so it was left to nothing.

    When everyone was leaving, two figures appeared in the shadow of the city wall, following Mo Feiye.

    Due to sleep reasons, Mo Feiye did all the inspection tasks at night. He knew that Fire-weary's long-term attack was ineffective, which made everyone in the city relax.

    Originally, he thought that Yanhuo's weak attack was due to the lack of ability of this group of Yanhuo. The arrival of Yuguichen made him completely overturn this view.

    Not to mention the disaster beasts and shamans that Yu Guichen talked about, as long as there were a few more of the Yanhuo that Yu Guichen was fighting against, Zhaoyao City wouldn't be able to withstand it.

    From then on, he felt that the goals of the Fire-weary people might have another conspiracy, and it was not as simple as simply capturing Zhaoyao City.

    With the strong support of Zhao Yaohou, Mo Feiye's suggestions were implemented efficiently. Various materials are neatly stacked in designated locations. The men, women, old and young, who were regrouped according to gender and age, also performed their duties faithfully in their respective positions without daring to show any signs of neglect.

    Mo Feiye patrolled all the way and clearly felt the crowd's displeasure. A few days ago, they would greet him warmly and thank him for coming to help defend the city. Now and in the past, they were all indifferent, and there was obvious resentment in some people's eyes.

    "The resentment is growing too fast." This is Mo Feiye's feeling. In just two months of siege, the resentment of the people has reached the level of the same city after two years of siege.

    Yu Guichen and the two followed Mo Feiye. She knew that after Mo Feiye finished checking the wood, he would go up the side stairs and go up to the city wall to check the sentry post. There would be no one on the stairs at this time, which was the best time for her.

    "Do you have immortal grass?"
